reviews.author: Park Baekja
reviews.text:
It's a Chinese restaurant with Taiwanese cuisine near Euljiro 1-ga Station.

It’s my first time seeing it, but it’s not an unfamiliar taste!
But it definitely tastes delicious.

Stir-fried fly head (25,000 won) did not contain flies!
It's stir-fried pork with garlic seeds, and I think it got its nickname because of its appearance.
The crunchy, delicious texture goes well with the savory stir-fried meat.

Mapo tofu (27,000 won) tasted like steamed Chinese food with spices and a soft texture like silken tofu.
The spicy food was so delicious when mixed with rice.
Perfect for someone who loves spice!

The packaging of Taiwanese apple cider is so cute.
I thought it would put RTS people in a good mood because it was the color of beer haha.

It has a slightly cozy feel that would be great for a group dinner!

reviews.author: H Cw

If you want to experience the authentic taste of authentic Chinese food in Euljiro, this is the place! The entire building is a restaurant, so it’s comfortable and the atmosphere is very classy.
​Dongpo pork is a work of art in its moistness that melts in your mouth, and the sweetness of the vegetables that increases the more you chew the stir-fried fly head is exquisite!  In particular, the plump shrimp and spicy umami in the mapo tofu are a taste that I keep thinking about..🥹
​It's a place where you can take pictures because it looks pretty, and you can feel the care put into each and every dish. 100% intention to revisit!! 💯👍

# Minho’s Pick A restaurant I want to visit again

I revisited Eulji Thai, a Thai restaurant, after two months. The point is that it is cooked by a Korean chef so it is not alien to Korean tastes. It was my mother's first time trying Thai cuisine, and I was proud that she was very satisfied with it. Good for beginners.

Recommended Menu
- Phu Pad Pong Curry, Pad Thai, Spicy Coconut Shrimp, Tom Yum Goong
- Stir-fried Gongsimchae, yam beef salad, fried eggplant (topping)

Pu Patppong curry is delicious and has an elegant, savory taste. Toppings include fried crab and fried eggplant. The fried texture was excellent and went well with the soft yellow curry. I also used soft shell crab to get the basics right!

Pad Thai was also delicious. The fish sauce has a nice tangy and sweet and sour taste. The noodles are soft and the nutty flavor is a bonus. I think it would have been better if the texture had been more varied by utilizing vegetable ingredients.

Nam Cone is a tom yum with a soft and rich flavor of coconut, and it is spicy and sour. This has quite a local flavor, so I think people will have different opinions. Pho/rice options available.

After trying both Gongsimtae and Yum Beef Salad as starters, I would recommend the former if you like Korean food, and the latter if you like spicy salads with balsamic flavor. I think I can easily eat a bowl of rice with just one stir-fried Gongsimchae!

reviews.author: WANGYOUNG LEE
reviews.text:
This is a review of Momoyama at Lotte Hotel Sogong-dong Main Branch, which was featured on the Michelin Plate. Originally, there were four levels of Michelin, from 1 to 3 stars to Bib Gourmand at a reasonable price of less than 35 euros, but The Plate has been quietly popping up a few years ago.

Restaurants with a price range of 5 million or more cannot enter the Bib Gourmand, but restaurants that are not enough to be given a star are included in the plate 🍽, so it is now common to see a total of 5 levels. It may seem like a trick, but you can enjoy the Michelin effect just by adding a plate.

The first reason to visit Momoyama is the Shinhan Card VIP benefits. A 20% discount is provided to those with birthdays who make reservations by phone. Dinner Omakase was only allowed for about 3 groups (6 people), but we made a reservation in advance at the end of February and were able to do it on a weekday.

Because it is located on the 38th floor, the top floor of the Lotte Hotel main building, the view is poor, but that is during the daytime, and the night view for dinner was not very beautiful due to fine dust and reflections from the glass windows. Still, the clear city view was worth seeing.

There were two teams starting the course earlier than me, and I started in the empty seat on the right. Since two seats are used by one person, it is very spacious. The omakase was served by a young chef next to the main chef. I felt trustworthy because he seemed sincere.

It starts with chawanmushi. There is finely sliced ​​tomato on top as a topping and there is nothing inside. It had a unique (slightly sloppy) appearance, but surprisingly the texture wasn't bad and this combination was delicious.

I ordered one ebisu-na mabiru and next came awabi-mushi. It was in the best condition, well-steamed, with a very soft and tender texture. The unique chewiness of abalone remained, and it was not tough at all and still had a chewy taste.

Miso soup wasn't included, so I asked for it and they said there wasn't any. Instead, they said they had another soup and prepared it for me, but it was jiri (tang). This is the clear soup that is usually served in hitsumabushi or unaju. I have no choice but to drink it.

It was refreshing, but I missed the cooler taste of miso soup! Sashimi came out. Because it is a counter sashimi, each type of sashimi is served to you one by one in front of you, not at Moriawase. Flatfish, red sea bream, and Odo came in that order. Although the quantity was very small, the taste was superb.

Let’s move on to sushi. The first round of sushi is completed in the order of horse mackerel, otoro, herring, and mackerel. Otoro (大とろ) was by far the best. The herring was slightly fishy, ​​but the mackerel had a good chewy texture and was less fishy. Azizushi (あじ寿司) was also good.

Before moving on to the second round of sushi, we were served cod dish (タラ) to whet our appetite. Because it was cooked while still retaining moisture, every time I chewed it, it felt like the juice was exploding in my mouth, giving me the joy of it.

The second round of sushi started without a break. Amaebi-Koika-Ikura-Shiroebi-Futomaki-Anago~! The sweet shrimp is always delicious, the cuttlefish was thick and hard to chew, and the salmon roe felt a bit salty.

The white shrimp sushi I had eaten a few times in the Toyama area of ​​Japan was enough to bring back memories, and Futomaki, which generously poured out ingredients and doubled the quantity, even gave me the bonus of taking it to-go, and Anago was a nag to say the least.

And a surprise was waiting. I knew about the birthday cake service and congratulatory lettering from reviews in advance, but when I started my second round of sushi, they made miso soup just for me. It is a touching moment, like receiving seaweed soup.

Ume (plum) was served as the first dessert, followed by fruit and ice cream as the second dessert, with a mini happy birthday message, and as seen in the review, there was even a candle on the piece cake! And all the staff sent congratulatory messages, so I had a happy birthday and came back. thank you

It came with 2 glasses of wine (can be replaced with iced tea), tom yum goong, som tam, pu pad pong curry, a piece of white rice, stir-fried chicken cashew nuts, pad thai, and dessert. The two of us were eating and our stomachs almost exploded. The food is all clean and good. I ate well~

Iced tea is really, really sweet.

Every time I come here, a lot of Thai people come too. It seems to suit Thai people well too.

reviews.author: olive
reviews.text:
I lived in Thailand for a while and I like Thai food.
Both the pho and Puppat Pong curry are the best Thai restaurants I've had in Korea. The atmosphere is calm, clean, well lit, and the owner is friendly. I highly recommend it

reviews.author: Choi Chan-dol (Chandoli)
reviews.text: This is a Thai food restaurant located in front of Myeongdong Cathedral. There are so many people. The taste is pretty good and the owner is very friendly. The price is a bit high.

reviews.author: Jihyun Yoon
reviews.text: I like tom yum goong, so I came here while looking for Thai Select Thai restaurant. The tom yum goong came out not long after I ordered it, and I was very satisfied with the smell. The taste was as expected and the quantity was okay. It's a bit expensive and you have to order rice separately, but I'm satisfied. Next time, I'll have to try Pu Pat Pong Curry.

reviews.author: Emergency escape (emergency escape)
reviews.text:
The interior is very good.
However, the Pad Thai noodles felt lumpy, and the Poo Pad Pong curry also felt like it was lacking in flavor by 2%.
However, since it is difficult to eat Thai food in Myeongdong, it is not a bad choice if you want to go to a Thai restaurant.

reviews.author: dragon dragon
reviews.text:
I've always wanted to come here and I finally got there❤️
It's so pretty because it's decorated in a Christmas atmosphere, and the food tastes amazing.. The garlic butter naan and tandoori chicken were especially delicious!! The staff are friendly and the store is spacious, so it would be great for dates, year-end gatherings, blind dates... haha. It's a restaurant I want to visit often~

reviews.author: sanghun lee (good devil)
reviews.text: Seeing how many Indian people visit, it seems like the food is a good take on the local taste and it's really delicious.

reviews.author: Yujoo
reviews.text:
Indian restaurant located across from Myeongdong Cathedral

You can see the cathedral from the window seat and the atmosphere is really nice. The interior of the store also feels cozy and sophisticated.
However, it was disappointing that there were quite a few menu items that could not be ordered, and wine bottles were not in stock, so the range of choices was limited.

(Advance reservation for window seats is recommended)

reviews.author: Professor Pig
reviews.text:
Taj, an Indian restaurant in Myeongdong!!
The couple set for 2 is good value and filling.
It had a view of Myeongdong Cathedral, so it was nice to look around while eating!
I liked the cleanliness of the store as there was a place to wash your hands.
The staff are also very friendly.

reviews.author: Suinan
reviews.text: First of all, the curry and naan are so overwhelmingly delicious. Shrimp is more delicious than tandoori chicken... I went on vacation and was lucky enough to eat at a window seat without a reservation, but reservations are usually required, so keep that in mind before you go!

reviews.author: Kim Se-hwan
reviews.text:
I ate Thai Basket’s Tom Yum Goong Pad Thai.
In general, it's okay, but the Pad Thai was a bit sweet and greasy for my taste. It's worth trying other dishes, too.

reviews.author: Kai Wei Lee
reviews.text: Great food and friendly service! I found it by chance while looking for a vegetarian restaurant for my mother in Myeongdong. I saw there was a vegetarian menu online and went to see it. Both owners were very kind, and even though we couldn't speak Korean, they treated us with the utmost care. We ordered fried fish, shrimp fish cake, stir-fried morning glory, coconut juice mushroom stew, and chicken skewers. The food was really authentic Thai food. All the dishes were delicious, and although the chicken skewers were a bit simpler than the other dishes, they were much more delicious than the Thai restaurants I've been to in Singapore. Mushroom stew looks bland on the outside, but when I actually tried it, it was full of flavor! The shrimp fish cakes were large, fresh, chewy and springy. The fried fish was good because it wasn't spicy but crispy and cooked well without bones. Be sure to visit! I was really satisfied with both the service and food! It cost about 105,000 won for 5 people and it was a good price!!!

reviews.author: yumei leung
reviews.text: I want to try food from other countries in Korea. The restaurant is clean and well organized, the food is delicious, and the shrimp Thai noodles are really fresh! Highly recommended! Take the elevator from the direction of the building shown in the first photo and go up to the 3rd floor!

reviews.author: Ted Weitz MD
reviews.text:
I can only imagine how much of a mess this place would have been if it were Gordon Ramsay.

The signage was attractive and looked good, but the service was pointless and slow. The food was so-so, and the worst thing was the background music.

It sounded like a New York subway speaker... I couldn't even guess what language it was. 🤷‍♂️

Someone mentioned green curry, which is my favorite dish, but it's thinned out with overcooked tough chicken and a slice of Thai eggplant...

There are many better options here 🤷‍♂️

reviews.author: chien liang Liu
reviews.text: A separate vegetarian menu is available. The food is delicious as it is cooked in an authentic way, and although it is a bit sweet, the aroma and flavor are really great. If you are sensitive to spicy food, please let us know in advance as the green curry is quite spicy. The food is so appetizing that you'll want to order a few bowls of it too! 😊

reviews.author: Victoria
reviews.text: Vietnamese cuisine restaurant! This is the main branch in Euljiro. This place is famous for its delicious rice noodles. This is a place where things are given without any finesse. Good to visit during busy lunch hours.

reviews.author: Sangpil Kim
reviews.text:
The food comes out within 5 minutes of ordering.
I went there for lunch and there were a lot of people and the turnover rate was good.
I ate a lot of tom yum, but the soup was so addictive that I kept eating it.
There are many places that charge extra for cilantro, but here, if you ask for more, they give you more.

reviews.author: injoong kim
reviews.text:
It's okay. It looks like a Vietnamese person is cooking.
The building is shabby, but the interior is decent.

Rice noodles cost about 10,000 won, spring rolls cost about 6,500 won (4pcs).
The price is not cheap, but I don't think it's expensive because it's a fun place to live in nearby Eulji.

The rice noodles are provided with separate toppings so you can add them according to your preference. I wish there was a little more meat, but
Soup and noodles are both okay.
However, rather than the low taste of Vietnamese street food,
It has a refined taste.
I ordered s, but the portion was a bit lacking. Next time I come, I think I will pay 1,000 won more and order L.

The spring rolls were satisfactory. I liked the moderate texture on the outside and felt it was similar to eating locally.

reviews.author: olive
reviews.text:
I lived in Vietnam for a year and a half
It is the taste of a delicious rice noodle restaurant even in the local area.
It was the most delicious Vietnamese rice noodles I had in Korea.
Personally, I like brisket rice noodles better than chadol, so I ate brisket, but if you like a bit greasy and heavy taste, you should try chadol.
The sauce for bunjja is strange. I don’t know why everyone in Korea makes Bunjja feel disconnected from the local culture.
I think the chef is a Vietnamese man and I am very satisfied.
The atmosphere of the store is cute and clean.
I love that the song is a Vietnamese song too.
However, they don't provide lime or lemon. It would be even better if you squeeze it into the rice noodles and eat it, but it's a shame. I'll have to ask for it next time.

reviews.author: Seo Jeong-hwa
reviews.text:
It's really delicious :D

But my boss doesn't like me leaving as it's closing time. (The expression on his face shows why he came. He has a very sullen expression, but he is very kind when he talks. You don’t have to feel bad because of his expression.)

You must go and order before 9 o'clock on weekdays at the latest.
I think it closes at 9:30 on weekdays and at 9:00 on holidays.

There is no parking, but there is a paid parking lot at a nearby gas station.
It's perfect to park there, eat, and then go to Starbucks across the street.

It's really delicious haha

reviews.author: Soobin Kim
reviews.text:
The atmosphere was so nice that it was perfect for a date.
It was near my anniversary, so I was able to get into the proper mood for the anniversary.
I was happier because the wine and food were so delicious.
The window seat looks really nice too.
The other places have a great atmosphere too!
I ordered a set menu for meat eaters.
It was even better because I was able to start with a refreshing meal and finish with a filling sirloin.
It's a place filled with hip sensibility and serious wine.
It's always nice to come here, whether for a date or a gathering!
I enjoyed it very much~

reviews.author: Sooyeon Shin
reviews.text: The atmosphere was exotic, with an interior full of Thai local sensibility and even music. I ordered pad thai and tom yum goong, and the spice balance was just right, so I enjoyed it without any hesitation. The visuals of the food were pretty, so it was a pleasure to the eyes. The staff were friendly and overall it was a satisfying meal.

reviews.author: puppy is cute
reviews.text:
First of all, the atmosphere is really nice. I think it has the best atmosphere of any wine bar I've ever been to. It's so fun because it feels a bit like I'm in real Thailand. It's a place you'll want to visit again next time. I like it so much haha
The wine and food are delicious too.

reviews.author: Mungrini
reviews.text: I didn't know there was such a cool wine bar in Euljiro 3-ga. Taste Thai food on a terrace filled with Southeast Asian sensibility. People who like wine and Southeast Asian food should definitely visit. I brought a friend with me this time and received lots of compliments.

reviews.author: Somsommi
reviews.text: It's been a while since I had really delicious Asian food. I only went to Euljiro because the restaurant's atmosphere was pretty, but I had a great time and felt like I was traveling abroad. Highly recommended.

address: 2nd floor, 12 Eulji-ro 12-gil, Jung-gu, Seoul, South Korea

reviews.author: Nam Hyun-sik
reviews.text:
This is a Vietnamese restaurant that I found after searching for a restaurant near Euljiro 3-ga. We went before 11:30 on a Friday and there were seats available when we arrived, but as we waited after ordering, the seats quickly filled up.
The interior of the restaurant is a bit rustic, but decorated with a Vietnamese feel.
We ordered a 4-person set and the food was generally delicious.  If I come to this area again, I plan to visit again.

reviews.author: Valletta
reviews.text:
Euljikankan, a Vietnamese restaurant hidden in an alley in Euljiro!
Are you looking forward to the rice noodle flavor selected in the Blue Ribbon Survey?
Pleasant truffle scent ~ Boyang rice noodles
Even the stir-fried beef tripe noodles had a strong smell of fire.
Jjajo on the outside and a glass of beer are a must!
The atmosphere, taste, and price were all perfect.
Hipjiro's emotional expedition was a success.

reviews.author: Some one
reviews.text:
The rice noodles and fried rice were delicious, especially the rice noodle soup. There is a long wait, so I recommend waiting in advance.

0

reviews.author: Lantern of flame
reviews.text:
This is a building where the stairs leading up show the passage of time.
It's on the 2nd floor, not the 1st floor.
When you open the door, the atmosphere suddenly changes.
This is not food tailored to Korean tastes.
You can enjoy the local taste of Vietnam.
This restaurant was also featured on TV.
The portions are generous and good.
Please note that reservations are not possible.
You must wait and then go in.

reviews.author: Yuna Kim
reviews.text:
I originally liked crab itself and rice noodles, so I visited Euljikan!
Looking for a commercial building and going up there...? I was wondering if this was the right place, but if you go in, you will find a little Vietnam!
The banh xeo and rice noodles are both delicious, and the soup is also very good.
A feeling worthy of hipjiro..!
However, I feel like it would be nice if the inside was a little cleaner...!

address: 2nd floor, 46 Supyo-ro, Jung-gu, Seoul, South Korea

reviews.author: Herena K
reviews.text: I went there because I heard it was delicious, but it was average to my taste. The Sigsicheo chop chop noodles tasted like Toowoomba Cup Ramen. I'll try the rice noodles next time. It was a weekend lunch, and I was lucky enough to not have to wait. It was full, but it was bright, clean, and friendly.

reviews.author: sunfish
reviews.text: Since I don't eat bean sprouts, I asked for just a little bit, so they accepted my request. The staff is very friendly and the food is delicious. The inside of the store is not large, so you may have to wait a bit depending on when you visit, but it's still delicious. The chop chop noodles have a lot of peanut flavor, so it's probably good for people who like peanut sauce.

reviews.author: olive
reviews.text: It seems like a place that sells Vietnamese and Thai food. Pork and garlic rice bowl is very delicious. It's a little sweet and salty, and it's a flavor you'll like regardless of whether you like it or not. Chop Chop Noodles seems to be a food developed here, and although it is familiar, it has a taste I have never tasted before. It feels like ramen soup added to rose spaghetti. I think it would be nice to add some peanut sauce to bring out the savory taste. It's tasty, but it's somewhat bland and lacking. I ordered Jjajo because the reviews were good, but it wasn't very good. It didn't taste like meat at all and only tasted like tofu, to the point where I wondered if it was vegan.  It's fried well and crispy, but it's definitely not recommended. The store was very clean and it was better because the lighting was lowered in the evening. The music was very good with chanson. The water is also good because it is barley tea. Overall, I feel like they cook with sincerity, so I'm curious about the other menu items. I intend to visit again.

reviews.author: pmh
reviews.text:
Chop Chop Noodles somehow felt familiar, but the taste wasn't what I was used to. It wasn't tasteless, but maybe a little greasy? It's cream ㅜㅜ but it's also spicy! It was delicious! More than that, the amount of rice noodles and chop chop noodles was no joke! I have about half left ㅜㅜ And I really recommend the sweet and sour pork!! It was crispy, sour, and so delicious!! For 19,000 won, there wasn't a lot of meat, but it was really delicious!!
The inside of the store wasn't large, but it was clean and pretty! The lighting made the food photos come out beautifully haha. I'm a little scared of the stairs... !

reviews.author: Shin Seul
reviews.text:
The taste of chop chop noodles was not something I have often tasted. (tasteless
(It doesn't mean it's amazing, it means it's amazing) Just mix the noodles in a thick peanut-based soup and eat it. The stir-fried beef with pepper was seasoned and good to eat with rice, and the stir-fried beef with oyster sauce and vegetables was really just an ordinary stir-fried meat with an oyster sauce base. They put a lot of unroasted green onions on the dish, but they looked old. Except for the chop chop noodles, it seems like an ordinary Thai restaurant.

address: 2nd floor, 6 Chungmuro 5-gil, Jung-gu, Seoul, South Korea

reviews.author: hongsi
reviews.text: They say it's run by a Thai wife and a Korean husband, so it's truly Thai!!! I've been to Thailand several times and it tastes really local!!! Everything on the menu is delicious and the set menu is also good.

reviews.author: Rachel
reviews.text: I ordered pig’s feet rice bowl! I ate it and it was better than most dongpo pork and it tasted so good that it was the meal of a lifetime!!! Other than the food I ate, the other foods were also very delicious, and the watermelon slush, Taengmoban, was really good because it tasted like a collection of all the good things:) They say all the ingredients and the food are made at Cai 9, and everything is said to be the traditional recipe of my Thai mother-in-law. What's surprising is that while it retains the authentic taste, it's so perfect for the Korean palate that I enjoyed it so much. When I tried the food, it tasted really good, and more than anything, I was impressed by the sincerity that was put into it. (^^) Everyone, be sure to try the Jokbal Rice Bowl. The portions are large, so you can get a good deal on it!!!

reviews.author: Winnie Lee
reviews.text:
This is a restaurant with a Thai street food feel.
The owner's wife says she's Thai.
The papaya salad was very delicious.
Kapao Moo Ssap and Pad Thai were a bit sweet and salty for our taste.
I also recommend Thai iced tea.

reviews.author: Songju Kim
reviews.text:
Why do you go to Thailand? There is Cai 9 on Euljiro 3-ga?
Every single menu item is delicious, the atmosphere is nice, and I want to go again.

reviews.author: kkku im
reviews.text:
The tom yang rice noodles are so delicious haha. You must order the som tam!!
It’s the same local taste!

address: 1st floor, 43-1 Chungmuro, Jung-gu, Seoul, South Korea

reviews.author: Kim Dong-wook
reviews.text:
I saw them making ham while eating rice noodles.
I need to eat banh mi.

display_name: Oh Hansu Beef Myeonga Jung-gu Branch

reviews.author: KP
reviews.text:
Hong Kong beef noodles (Korean version?) are delicious. You can eat it with clear soup at first and then add seasoning and make it spicy.
Considering the unlimited refills of air rice, noodles, and soup, and people waiting, I only ate rice mixed with soup.
Four fried dumplings cost 9,000 won, but the common opinion of the people I went with was that it wasn't worth paying up to 9,000 won for.
I plan to visit again next time.

reviews.author: MI YOUNG Go
reviews.text:
As someone who tried beef noodle for the first time, I can't judge whether it's delicious beef noodle. However, it was delicious enough and a filling meal. Looking at the people around me, they kept refilling my soup and even provided me with rice if I wanted it.
And first of all, I thought it would be really good for office workers who don't have enough time for lunch because the food came out quickly.
If you ask for extra cilantro, they give you a lot of it. As someone who likes cilantro, I really liked it^^

reviews.author: Ji “It’s in your heart” C
reviews.text:
Beef stew noodle with a clean taste that is easy to eat without any likes or dislikes
It is a popular flavor with a low entry level, even for beginners.

The combination of soft noodles and rich broth makes it great to slurp, and the meat is also delicious. After enjoying the basic taste to a certain extent, if you try a little bit of the spicy dadeggi placed on the table, what can I say... a refreshing taste? It turns into a spicy gukbap soup style that Koreans like. It's attractive.

Personally, I prefer exotic flavors, so the beef noodle tasted too average for me, but I think it's clear that everyone will like it. Kimchi and pickled radish are served as side dishes.

I added a lot of coriander and enjoyed it.

reviews.author: JK PARK
reviews.text:
Light beef soup and hotpot broth
Naju Gomtang is a mild beef noodle soup with not much spice flavor, but I don't think it's necessarily Korean.
The meat was tender and the boiled chives had a good broth, so even if we ordered a small size, we were still full for dinner for two.
You can order dumplings (steamed, steamed) individually, so you can enjoy them like an appetizer before a meal.

reviews.author: Kim Dong-wook
reviews.text: Good for lunch. In addition to cilantro, you can add noodles and rice for free.

display_name: Oh My For DGB Financial Center Branch

reviews.author: Dillisus
reviews.text:
It’s been a while since I ate delicious rice noodles.
However, it was a bit disappointing that green onions were added instead of cilantro.

reviews.author: Warren Wigh
reviews.text: The pho is really delicious and definitely fresh. It's closer to Korean style than Vietnamese style, but it's still delicious. Recommended. It can be crowded during lunch time as it is crowded with office workers.

address: 1st floor, 116 Namdaemun-ro, Jung-gu, Seoul, South Korea
2nd floor, Woosuk Building, Jung-gu, Seoul, Korea

reviews.author: Digital Nomad
reviews.text:
Tuna sashimi... It's a burdensome price to eat often.
The lowest price per person at most tuna restaurants is close to 40,000 won. It's hard to expect bluefin tuna at this price.

However, it is said that this place only handles large bluefin tuna.
And it is a room-only place with no hall or counter seats. You can eat quietly.
The staff came by regularly after knocking and I was treated well.

The quality and taste of the tuna, the accompanying food, and the service are all good.

I visited for dinner with two people and ate the special for 58,000 won per person.
As I ate the food that came with the basic side dishes because it was delicious... I only got one refill.
Two people who had their own backs went....

I highly recommend it if you like tuna, especially bluefin tuna (honmaguro). I've never seen a place this cheap.
There is a bluefin tuna restaurant that I like, but they only serve about 12 pieces. Without any other food.

Personally, it's a shame that I can't drink alone because it's not within my range of living (I'll have to call and ask if I can drink alone...)

reviews.author: Kevin Golf
reviews.text:
I think tuna is the best.
The price is reasonable, they give you good portions, and you never have to tip, so it's all private and nice.

reviews.author: GC NAM (neighborhood restaurant visiter)
reviews.text:
Private room for all seats
The tuna is in good condition and the food is also good.
Friendly staff, no tips accepted
The price is a bit high, but I will visit again if I eat tuna in Euljiro.

reviews.author: Jun Hwang
reviews.text:
2 people, lunch special
The tuna quality is good.
Better than 35,000 levels elsewhere
There are no staff tips.

reviews.author: in the cabin
reviews.text:
The tuna that came out first had a bit of a smell, probably because it had been thawed incorrectly, and wasn't very good.
The tuna head that came later was the best~!!
The staff are all friendly..

display_name: Baan Khun Kwan| Ban Khun Kwan| บ้านคุณกวัน
address: 3rd floor, 20 Jongno 10-gil, Jongno-gu, Seoul, South Korea

reviews.author: Winnie Lee
reviews.text:
As soon as I ordered, the food came out so quickly that I thought it was just microwaved. Maybe that's why the food didn't taste very good.
Cacao is cheap.  I thought this would be a difficult dish to make without it being delicious, but I got to try it here.
It's not at the level of a meal kit, and I think it'll be this much even if you just heat it in a retort microwave.
The pad thai my husband ate was just a stir-fried egg.
I was embarrassed because it was my first time eating such delicious Thai food.
The interior was nicely decorated, but the air was very stuffy due to too many tables being crammed into a small space.

reviews.author: J
reviews.text: I added a somtam to the 2-person set B. Overall, the price-quality ratio was good. Although it was a set menu, there was quite a bit of fried crab in the curry and shrimp in the pad thai, and it was reasonably delicious. I like somtam, and it was refreshing, chewy, and savory with plenty of peanuts.

reviews.author: Dawn Lee
reviews.text:
The interior is cute and has a Thai feel! The atmosphere is great too! When I saw the Thai-style partitions and lighting, and the Phuket drink advertising paper on the wall, I felt like I was in Thailand!

The food is also very delicious! The Poo Pad Pong Curry had a nice coconut scent, and the fried stuff on top was very soft and delicious! The crab meat fried rice was delicious just by itself! The pork barbecue was also delicious. It's quite expensive compared to the amount, but it's worth the money.

reviews.author: Minji Kim
reviews.text: The Poo Pad Pong curry was soft and sweet. Since the soft crab fried on top is crab, won't it be hard no matter how much you fry it? I did it at all. It had a pleasant crunch. When I ate the body and legs in one bite, it didn't taste very good. It did not appear in the area where only the legs were. It was delicious though! I almost added a bowl of rice. Was it shrimp vermicelli salad? I don't remember the name of the menu exactly, but the salad was refreshing, spicy, and delicious. The peanuts inside went well with it. I recommend ordering one main dish and this salad as well. However, be careful when eating it as it is quite spicy. I want to come back and try other foods I haven't tried before. And I like that the atmosphere of the store is exotic!

reviews.author: Kyobin Koo
reviews.text:
One of the few Thai restaurants near Euljiro~Jonggak.
(There are relatively many Vietnamese restaurants that sell rice noodles.)

The entrance road is cumbersome and inconvenient, but the store is larger than expected. It has a large capacity and can accommodate many people (for company dinners, etc.), so it is crowded, but it seems to turn around quickly.

The delicacy here is Khao Pat Pu (crab fried rice).
The generous amount of crab meat and carefully stir-fried rice create a rare taste.

This is a place that combines three things: prompt service from skilled employees, quick order processing, good sense of food, and taste.

Considering the quality of the food, the price is cheap.

display_name: Andy Kwan Vietnamese Pho Beer Lounge

reviews.author: Sani “SANI TV” Choi
reviews.text:
The food is delicious, but other parts are a bit disappointing.
The food tastes good. Good value for money too
8,000 won per person

reviews.author: Taeyoung Kwak
reviews.text: It's delicious haha Koreans only go there during lunch time haha It's a bar for Vietnamese people in the evening so it's crazy haha

reviews.author: comcom com
reviews.text:
The smell of cigarettes wafting from the entrance, loud Vietnamese music blares, and as you enter the hall, all the Vietnamese people's attention is focused on you. I wanted to eat pho, so I went in after seeing pho written on the sign, but did I come in wrong? I feel like I was mistaken. Once you are seated, you shout out, “Please give me some rice noodles.” So, the rice noodles that came out a few minutes later were special. The earthen pot contains boiling broth, and raw meat, noodles, vegetables, and meatballs are served separately. When I try to put the noodles in first, the staff member shouts in awkward Korean. “Sir, you have to eat the meat first!” Put the noodles back down and put the raw meat first as instructed, then add the remaining ingredients. So, I finally tasted rice noodles. You can smell the subtle scent of spices from the broth. Then I tasted a bite of the meatball, ah! The strong scent of cloves and cumin, followed by a few subtle spice scents, the smell of cigarettes inside the store, the music, and the Vietnamese language all come together to create the illusion of eating at a Vietnamese market. Afterwards, I was intoxicated by the scent of spices that lingered throughout my meal, and I sat up after eating my fill.

It has a strong spice scent and a bit of an atmosphere, so I can't recommend it to others. A place worth stopping by if you miss rice noodles with a strong spice flavor.

reviews.author: Sujin Y
reviews.text:
The price, food and taste are all great ㅠㅠㅠㅠㅠㅠㅠㅠ
It’s so delicious I love you 💜

reviews.author: Lee In-seon
reviews.text: It was a house that wasn't visible because it was underground, or a hidden restaurant.

reviews.author: Keumlan Hwang
reviews.text:
You can find Thai food in Euljiro.
There is a set menu, but we ordered it a la carte so we could choose what we wanted to eat.
Tetman kung (fried shrimp meat) 2 pieces. It’s really full of shrimp meat!!
If I go next time, I will definitely order it. There are 2 to 4 pieces, and each additional piece costs 3,000 won.
If there are 3 people in your group, please order one additional dish to taste it.
Stir-fried soft crab curry is the main dish at this restaurant. It is called Pu Pad Ponggari and the crab is soft enough to be eaten with the shell. It is delicious with scrambled eggs, so it is good when mixed with rice. I ordered the tom lamb noodles because I wanted to eat gungmulryu. It has the unique scent of lemon grass and lime leaves, but it is fragrant. Haha. The gunk water is also refreshing and I want to eat it as a hangover.
I like cilantro, so I asked for it separately.
Pad Thai goong, a Thai stir-fried noodle dish, is topped with shrimp and is plentiful and delicious.
Overall, it's Thai food, but it's not unpleasant to eat and it's delicious.

reviews.author: Champ Yang
reviews.text:
#Visit #Thailand from #Euljiro🇹🇭
#I fried whole shrimp🦐
Of course it's cool and the coconut scent is attractive🥥
Addictive #greencurry 🍛🥘

I'm satisfied that the two get along well👍🏻

reviews.author: Kyobin Koo
reviews.text:
This Thai restaurant is located in the basement of the Center One building, so it is conveniently connected to Euljiro Entrance/Euljiro 3-ga underground (the walking distance is considerable) and the clean building makes it a perfect place for important gatherings.
The prices of main dishes such as Poo Pat Pong Curry tend to be around 40,000 to 50,000 won per person for a formal meal with alcohol, and around 30,000 won per person for an economical meal.
Given the price range, it's not crowded, and the staff service is good for the price, so I keep coming back to this place again.

reviews.author: Yoo Min-hee
reviews.text:
Tom Yum Noodles that even people who are not good at eating Tom Yum can easily eat, and Puppappong Curry that even children can enjoy.
(There are children's dishes, children's chairs, and the bathroom is clean (however, the bathroom is not child-friendly/I don't like the sensor sink.))
It was a perfect holiday with 4 hours of parking, including a meal followed by a walk along Cheonggyecheon.

reviews.author: Passionate Bangka
reviews.text:
Ahan Thai Euljiro Center 1 branch.
Center One Basement 1st floor. It's a good idea to make a reservation during lunch time at 12 o'clock.
...
It can be described as a high-end restaurant with Korean-style Thai food.
Menus such as single meals, set menus, and lunch sets are accompanied by photos.
It's well organized so making a choice isn't difficult.
However, the cost of the meal is just double!
If there are 3 people going, it would be nice to have a side menu for 2 people.

address: 1st floor, 5 Jongno 8-gil, Jongno-gu, Seoul, South Korea

reviews.author: Im Sang-hyeon
reviews.text: The interior of the store is luxurious and sophisticated, and there are plenty of tables, so it is recommended as a place for dates and group gatherings. They sell a variety of Indian dishes, so you can enjoy them to your taste. The portions are generous for the price, so it is good value for money. The combination of naan and curry is delicious, and the tandoori chicken is a delicacy. ^^ Recommended as a place for a weekend outing ♡

reviews.author: Mrs. Rani
reviews.text:
I went around 5 o'clock and there weren't many customers, which was nice. It's the best naan and curry I've ever had. The freshly baked naan was moderately soft, the two types of curry were also very fragrant and contained cubic cheese, and the salad was fresh and really delicious.
100% intention to revisit!

reviews.author: wj J
reviews.text: This was the first proper Indian food I had since returning to Korea. Naan is really delicious. However, as with curry, you should be prepared for the price. It's not very expensive.

reviews.author: Woodsin
reviews.text: This store shouldn't exist in Korea... I bought a set for 2 people for 60,000 won. If I were to cook, I could cook for 5,000 won. I feel hungry even after eating. Writing this is pretty much the best I can do.

reviews.author: SeokLye Hong
reviews.text: Salad. Dalmakhni curry. Beef chili curry. Tandoori chicken full. I ordered 3 pieces of rice and 3 people ate our fill. The atmosphere was a bit disappointing, but the food was good and the food was delicious. I think I may visit again.

address: 2nd basement level, Mirae Asset Building, 26 Euljiro 5-gil, Suha-dong, Jung-gu, Seoul, Korea
short_address: 2nd basement level, Mirae Asset Building, 26 Eulji-ro 5-gil, Suha-dong, Jung-gu

reviews.author: Seunghwan Jang
reviews.text:
On a happy Christmas day, I had lunch with my family. We made a reservation for 6 people, but the place wasn't full, and it was difficult to understand that we were seated narrowly at the round table at the end. It was winter, so when we asked for space to put our coats or bags, they said there were no hangers and told us to just hang them on chairs, which made sitting uncomfortable.
They say it's an Indian food restaurant, but the food is salty and personally, I don't think the thickness and taste of the naan is worth paying 30,000 won per person for compared to other Indian restaurants.
The most absurd incident was that when I tried to calculate the remaining amount excluding the 40,000 won paid in advance as a reservation deposit, I couldn't help but laugh at the answer that the reservation deposit of 40,000 won would be sent to my account within a month.
This is a restaurant I never want to go to again.

reviews.author: for good
reviews.text: I went to Agra, which has a great atmosphere, good taste, and great visuals. I think the interior is better than before. The menu seems to have changed a bit, but if you order the premium menu, you get naan and rice and unlimited drinks, so I ordered the premium couple set for 57,600 won. The curry with 8 pieces of mango grape bread and chicken tandoori wings was butter chicken makhni curry, Goa proun curry, mangorassi naan, and rice. Butter chicken makhni curry. It was okay and I ordered it most of the time, but I don't think I will order it next time. The Goa Proun curry was a little spicy and had one red pepper on it, but I think it was spicier than Shin Ramyun, but it was delicious because it took away the greasiness. I think I'll order the Goa Proun curry next time. The tandoori wings were so soft and the mango grape bread was delicious, and a lot of families came. You might think 57,600 won is expensive, but if you go to the buffet, it costs about this amount for two people, so I think it's not bad value for money. Parking is not a problem in Jongno, where parking is difficult as it is located in Center One Building. The downside is that you cannot eat without getting your hands dirty. I think I use 10 wet wipes when I come here. If you go to Jongno, I highly recommend Agra~

reviews.author: Marcus Odin
reviews.text: Indian restaurant. In short, this is a place where you will be satisfied with the interior the moment you first walk in, and once you order the food, you will be twice as satisfied with the visuals of all the menu items. Due to the nature of Indian food, the taste is not fancy or surprising. However, if you want to surprise someone with its atmosphere and visuals, this is a highly recommended place.

reviews.author: MH K
reviews.text: The store has a great atmosphere and the interior is luxurious and pretty! The staff is friendly and the food comes out very quickly. The naan served with snowing bread was a bit hard, which was disappointing, but the tandoori chicken, curry, fresh naan, and lassi were all delicious. The honey butter naan is slightly sweet, the classic naan is savory, and there are even truffle garlic and garlic naan.

reviews.author: Andrew Kim
reviews.text: While I was wondering what to eat today... I searched around and found a 10-year-old Indian restaurant and went there. There is a 10th anniversary promotional menu. I ordered Set B, which includes tandoori chicken. The price is very reasonable as it costs 15,600 won including curry, tandoori chicken, naan, fried rice (Indian style), and drink. The portion was generous, and I especially loved the chewy texture of the naan. The interior atmosphere is also very unique and memorable.

reviews.author: Chris Park
reviews.text:
The price has risen a lot since the beginning (9,800 won for brisket, 13,000 won for chadol) and I don't know if the taste has gone down or if my taste buds have adapted.
I came here often because it's the main branch and it tastes better than other Emoi stores, but I don't think I'll ever come again because it's more expensive than the taste. (Other emoys are even worse)

P.s It's still better here than other franchise pho restaurants.

+I moved my company nearby, so I go there often these days, and the Vietnamese rice noodles are the best and the best.

reviews.author: Dongsik
reviews.text:
It may be difficult to find as it is located in a corner.
Very crowded during lunch time.
It is a popular flavor and has become a franchise, so it is now easy to find.
The price is not cheap.

reviews.author: Yoonkyoung Kim
reviews.text:
it is delicious! Is it because they use raw noodles?
The buncha was delicious and, uniquely here, pickled garlic is served as a basic side dish.
It wasn't easy to find as it was inside a busy shopping mall.
There were a lot of people when I went for lunch on a weekday.

reviews.author: J S
reviews.text: It was my first time visiting Bunjja and my first time at Emory, and since it was the main branch, I went there with high expectations, but was only disappointed. The spicy rice noodles were too salty and the quantity was not as good as it looked. The noodles were all stuck together and couldn't be separated. This was the worst pho restaurant.

reviews.author: Kiwoong Park
reviews.text: Recommended for those who like rice noodles. The soup is Korean-style, refreshing and fragrant to whet your appetite, and the noodles are chewy as if they were pulled well. The downside is that it's a bit expensive, but I think it's worth it.

address: Room 707, 7th floor, Jangyo Building, 363 Samil-daero, Jung-gu, Seoul, Republic of Korea
short_address: Room 707, 7th floor, Jangjan Building, 363 Samil-daero, Jung-gu

reviews.author: Nayeong Kim
reviews.text: I visited on a weekday evening. (I think they are closed on weekends) I first ordered two menu items and tried them by the spoonful. It was so delicious that I ordered two additional menu items and a beer. Overall, it is good value for money at a price of around 10,000 won. The morning glory plate was full, and the stir-fried pork belly vegetables were also very delicious. Overall, the seasoning was appropriate, so it was the first time in a while that I had a delicious dinner. I will come again to try the menu I haven’t tried 💕🥹

reviews.text: The store is clean and it’s so delicious.

reviews.author: Regina
reviews.text: It's delicious

reviews.author: Deborah
reviews.text: Had a great time at this restaurant. The food was great and delicious. The staff were also kind and friendly. I placed a takeout order and everything was delivered safely. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Neil McKellar
reviews.text: The food was really delicious. I don't know how to eat pancakes, though.

reviews.author: Traveler4Ever
reviews.text:
Warm welcome and very friendly waiters.
The food was really delicious. I ate three dishes, two with spicy squid and one with pork.
The portion was generous and tasty, and the soup was really delicious.
I highly recommend this restaurant.

reviews.author: Winnie Lee
reviews.text:
I always order and eat banh xeo at many places in Hoang Viet, but here it takes a while to come out, but it is grilled on the spot to make it crispy and comes out warm. However, there is also the downside that the contents are so sticky that they drip down.
I recommend Goi Cuon Summer Roll as it is thick and delicious.

reviews.author: Bart Chang
reviews.text:
I like the soup because it is very thick.
It was nice that they gave us a lot of coriander and bamboo wine and they were friendly.

I also like the owner who welcomes me happily.

reviews.author: John HAN
reviews.text: A place I happened to visit made me want to have another drink

reviews.author: R.M Lee
reviews.text: I visited recently, and the Vietnamese employees were so loud and argumentative that I felt uncomfortable. The tableware was handled so noisily that even simple English communication was difficult.

reviews.author: Warren Wigh
reviews.text: It was truly authentic Vietnamese food! The food was deliciously cooked and we enjoyed every bite. The quantity was just right. The soup was also really delicious. Highly recommended if you want to experience authentic Vietnamese food.

reviews.author: My God Oh
reviews.text:
1. Enjoy the atmosphere of a Vietnamese restaurant
2. In Vietnam, if you compare the prices and food quality of high-end restaurants in Vietnam, they are at the level of cheap restaurants.
3. The rice noodles are too bland.

reviews.author: HUN KIM
reviews.text: It was a Vietnamese-style restaurant, and it was nice that the Vietnamese staff personally served and prepared the food, but it was an ordinary Vietnamese restaurant rather than just delicious, but the prices were Korean prices. It was disappointing that the prices were expensive but the portions were not large.

reviews.author: Ei Fukui
reviews.text:
I went because I wanted to have a few beers after dinner. I liked the atmosphere of the food stalls. Plus, the draft beer is 2900W!
The young male staff (Vietnamese?) was also gentle, the food tasted good and the atmosphere was great!

It looks like you can substitute Pho's noodles for free once.

reviews.author: Maksim Gornozhenko
reviews.text: This is a hearty soup cafe. Despite the simple interior, you can feel free to go in and order any dish. There is also an English menu for your convenience. Every table is provided with orange ice water, but I didn't know what kind of water it was, so I ordered a beer. Beer is more reliable. The pho bo soup is really great. Rich broth, high-quality meat, and great toppings!

reviews.author: Sam Hsieh
reviews.text: You can also taste authentic Vietnamese rice noodles (pho) in Korea, and it is open 24 hours a day and the prices are reasonable.

address: Basement 1, Seoul, Republic of Korea 6 KR Jongno 12-gil, Jongno-gu, Seoul
short_address: Basement 1st floor 6 KR Jongno 12-gil, Jongno-gu, Seoul

reviews.author: Winnie Lee
reviews.text:
The owner is an Indian, and more than half of the customers are Indian.
A lunch set that suits the Korean taste is good value for money, and the naan is so large that I can eat it without running out of food.

reviews.author: Sehyun YANG
reviews.text:
It's a store with a very local atmosphere (even though I've never been there).
There are always a lot of non-Koreans as customers.
This is a place where you can eat delicious curry and naan at a reasonable price.

reviews.author: Hong Jun-ki
reviews.text:
For lunch, I ordered lunch set B (13,900 won).
The portions are so large that I could just have the 9,900 won lunch A.

When you look at the table setting, it looks like the portion is a bit lacking, but it is a lot bigger than you think. In particular, they give you two naan per person, which is huge.

The lassi is a bit too sweet. This is something I don't like...
The salad is a bit weird because it's ketchup and mayonnaise, but since it's a lunch set menu, I guess that's okay.

Chicken is uncomfortable to eat. It's too inconvenient to slice and eat elegantly with a knife...
It would be better to order a different side since it comes with 4 pieces of chicken instead of 2, or order that because the 9,900 won version does not come with chicken.

The curry is also delicious. The tea Asia curry you get at the supermarket tastes exactly the same.

Lastly, the rice is regular Korean rice.
It's not Indian rice. Well, I guess it's a lunch set menu.

reviews.author: minseo
reviews.text:
Date of visit: June
Overall, I liked it because it didn’t have a spicy taste.
Unlike other places, the tandoori chicken was so big that I couldn't eat it all.
And the curry in particular is so delicious that it reminds me of it again.

reviews.author: Ji Kyeong-woo
reviews.text:
An Indian curry restaurant located in Jonggak Youth Street.

In the past, it was an Indian curry restaurant called ‘Jyoti’, but it seems they changed the name.

The inside of the store is spacious and quiet. The place is not crowded for weekday lunch.

When you see the TV showing Indian music videos, the unique smell of spices, the local-like staff, and the metal cutlery, you get the feeling of being in the local area.

They sell a lunch set menu, but the range of choices is very limited, so I think the answer is already decided.

There are a lot of naan and rice, so you can eat to your fill, and the price is not too burdensome. There aren't many Indian curry restaurants around, and the price includes lassi, so it's not bad value for money.

In some cases, it may take some time to serve food after ordering, so people who need lunch in a hurry are recommended to find another restaurant.

reviews.author: Asuka S
reviews.text: It was in a place where you might be a little surprised if you went at night, but it is a store where you can feel safe once you enter. The man may seem foolish, but the mother's smile, kindness, and atmosphere make the two of them look great, and the water parsley pork belly is the best! Mom's tenderness and smile somehow brought me to tears! You can eat a lot of vegetables and even though it's thinly sliced ​​meat, it's the best! It was great to choose here! We even had a feast!

address: -ga, 107-1 Jongno 3-ga, Jongno-gu, Seoul, Republic of Korea

reviews.author: saba garani
reviews.text: It's one of my favorite bars.

reviews.author: Ellie
reviews.text:
I ordered a set menu of Chicago pizza and seafood salad with a friend who loves cheese, and unlike before, the pizza was much sweeter.

I didn't like it because it was too sweet, but my foreign friend liked it.

Maybe that’s why everyone around me is foreigners

reviews.author: Lee Ha-hyun
reviews.text: The price is around 20,000 to 25,000 won. It was so thick that it looked like every part of the pizza. At the end, you can think of the dough as almost the entirety of the bread. The pizza size is smaller than expected. A little smaller than Pizza School? You can eat the whole plate by yourself or easily share it with two people. The original pizza is the best in terms of price and taste.

reviews.author: Park Low
reviews.text:
🙋‍♂️You can easily find it if you go down an alley just a short distance from the main street of Myeong-dong. The store is spacious and has a slightly open kitchen interior. Payment is made in advance, and payments and orders must be made in person. Payment was made by the person in the kitchen, but I deducted one star because of his bad attitude.
There is a small self-serve bar where you can bring hot sauce, garlic dipping sauce, pickles, and jalapenos. You must bring your own water, cups, and any drinks you order.
We were surprised because the pizza was smaller than expected, but the three of us ate to our hearts' content with the original pizza set for 40,000 won. (I was afraid it wouldn't be enough, so I added a salad to the set for 3,000 won and ordered fries as a side menu.) The pizza overall was satisfactory. As expected from Chicago pizza, the amount of cheese was enormous and the dough was not bad. I was disappointed with the cream pasta because it was too thin and only tasted like milk. Still, it's a pizza restaurant, so I guess that's the case. If you are ordering an additional set or side, I recommend French fries over pasta.

reviews.author: Jeong Min-jeong (PoNo)
reviews.text:
I ate the half and half pizza set.
I had seafood salad and bulgogi & shrimp pizza.
The pizza itself was very delicious. There was a lot of cheese and the dough was chewy♥
It was nice that I didn’t feel bloated~
There were many different types of carbonated beverages, so it was fun to choose.

The self-service bar and salad felt a bit lackluster.

reviews.author: Dragon Dragon Gari
reviews.text: I didn't know about this good place until now. Cheese on pizza is no joke. I asked for pasta, but I felt full, so I ate salad. They gave me a lot of salad, but it was so delicious that I felt like it wasn't enough. It was good. Next time, I'm going to try pasta.

display_name: Pizzeria O Myeongdong Branch Pizzeria O Myeongdong

reviews.author: Seongjin Seo
reviews.text:
I received a flyer on the street and went to see it!

Unlike Korean pizza, I could really taste the original taste of the ingredients, so it was my first time eating proper pizza in a while.
The service was very good. Recommended.

Of all the pizzas I ate today, ‘Nduya’ was the most delicious!
I could taste the creamy cheese, roasted garlic, basil, and olive oil on a large slice of pizza. The roasted garlic had a kick to my taste.
When you think of ‘Pitcheriao’, you probably think of Nduya.

‘Patate et Beurstel’ was more ordinary than I expected. Since they said it was Mega Crunch, I thought it would be sweet like a salad bar style, but it was just French fries.

reviews.author: dike
reviews.text: Because it was a holiday, we went out to Myeongdong and my grandson, who likes pizza, wanted to eat it, so he came in. The pizza dough must have been fermented well, so it's chewy and baked in an oven, so it's really delicious.

reviews.author: Youngran Jeong
reviews.text:
It’s been a while since I visited Myeongdong~
I happened to stop by while I was thinking about where to go, and maybe because it's a wood-fired pizza, it's really delicious, different from the pizza I usually eat haha.
My son and daughter both enjoyed it very much. Haha
Not only the pizza, but also the aglio olio was moderately spicy and went well with the pizza and was delicious.
It wasn't easy to find a good restaurant when I came to Myeongdong, but now I have to come here from now on.
I highly recommend it😄

reviews.author: Mirae Noh
reviews.text:
Pizza and pasta are really delicious~
Especially the pizza is perfect
Chewy Chewy It’s no joke🥰👍❤️

reviews.author: Lim So-yoon
reviews.text: The food is so delicious and most of all, the service is great. The staff are all so kind. There are many foreigners and I recommend it.

address: 3rd to 5th floors, 8 Myeongdong 6-gil, Jung-gu, Seoul, South Korea

reviews.author: Yunyoung
reviews.text: It's a restaurant with a nice atmosphere! The price is not cheap, but it was so delicious that I was satisfied with the meal. I highly recommend the Tomato Ragu Pasta..🤍 I want to visit again.

reviews.author: Dewani Cage
reviews.text:
A quiet and bright restaurant, one of the few in Myeong-dong. It consists of a dark and sophisticated 2nd floor, a bright and friendly 3rd floor, and a private 4th floor. There is plenty of space between tables, making it great for conversation.

The food taste is average. The Caprese salad was sparse, but had decent cheese and dressing, and the pizza also had good fresh mozzarella cheese, but the dough was thin and crispy, so people may not like it.

Recommended menu item is risotto. The truffle flavor and chewy texture combine well and are delicious.

reviews.author: Namaste
reviews.text:
Such a waste of space in the middle of Myeongdong?? Enter with this thought!!!

The food quality was really, really great.
It was really delicious and the price was reasonable.

The wine corkage is 25,000 per bottle, but I don't think it's expensive at all.

It's a gem-like house with excellent value for money. The atmosphere is very nice and there are various types of room conditions, including rooftop, so this is also a great point.

reviews.author: hotzzi
reviews.text:
- There was a place like this in an alley in Myeongdong! Maybe it's because of the coronavirus or because it's a hidden restaurant, but it was nice because there were no people and it was quiet!
- The food and atmosphere are Italian! Risotto, pasta, and thin pizza are all delicious, and the wine list and desserts are also good.

reviews.author: PG Lee
reviews.text: This is an Italian restaurant with a warm and cozy atmosphere located inside an alley in Myeongdong. The pasta and appetizers are both delicious, but the salad isn't that great, so I'm subtracting one star.

address: #112, 1st floor, 10 Beopwon-ro 4-gil, Songpa-gu, Seoul, Republic of Korea

reviews.author: Daisy
reviews.text: All the food was really delicious. However, the plates were not replaced even after the third dish was served, so we had to ask for them to be replaced, so I wonder what it would have been like if they had done so in advance… Still, the food was so delicious that I think I'll visit again.

reviews.author: Hamchorong
reviews.text:
I think you should definitely make a reservation for lunch!
On the menu, pasta comes out quickly, but steak takes a bit of time. The atmosphere is nice and a bit pricey, but it's great for a lunch meeting!

reviews.author: Mina Park
reviews.text: I found this place while looking for a restaurant with a nice atmosphere to celebrate my friend's birthday! The cave-like interior felt very special and cozy. It's quiet and dark, so I think it would be a good choice for dinner. I enjoyed all four menu items I chose today. The pasta topped with sweet shrimp had an impressive spicy scent from black pepper. As soon as I took a bite of the Grotta gnocchi and green onion cream sauce, my mouth was filled with the scent of green onions, which was amazing. It had a mild taste in contrast to the sweet shrimp pasta. The Sicilian seafood saffron risotto was extremely delicious, with a slightly sweet taste from the shrimp meat on top. And the finale was classic tiramisu! As we wrapped up today's meal, we had a satisfying meal until the very end. I was able to create another fun and happy memory with my friends at Variegata Myeongdong branch. For a special day, I recommend dinner in Variegata. 🩷

reviews.author: Hyemin Kang
reviews.text:
This is a recommended place if you want to taste high-quality fusion Italian. The interior of the store is modern with a sea cave concept, and the gnocchi with green onion cream sauce that goes well with it is a particularly recommended menu item as it looks and tastes good.
The overall taste is good and it's great for a date, year-end gathering, or brunch.
Myeongdong Shinsegae Department Store and Lotte Department Store are located nearby, so it was great to enjoy the lighting ceremony and the market.
(This is an honest review written after receiving part of the service)

reviews.author: Dalia
reviews.text: It seems like it just opened, but there are a lot of customers so you need to make a reservation. There are a lot of office workers, so it's more crowded after 12:30. The restaurant interior is pretty and the staff are very friendly. The food menu is unusual and good. I had sweet shrimp tartare, sweet shrimp butter pasta, and seafood saffron risotto, and I was satisfied with all of them.

reviews.author: What should I do, life?
reviews.text:
I found a restaurant with a nice atmosphere located on the 11th floor of the UNESCO building across from the Lotte main branch..!
The atmosphere was nice thanks to the large window view and soft lighting.
Blueberry & Arugula Pizza
Perhaps because the dough was aged for 72 hours, it was chewy and crispy.
The combination of fresh ingredients was especially attractive.
The Vongole Agliolio had a deep, clean taste with plenty of clams.
The staff are also very friendly!
It was a great place to have a meal in a cozy atmosphere after shopping in Myeongdong, and I highly recommend the pizza. You must try it!

reviews.author: Ganini
reviews.text:
The atmosphere was really nice with a view of Namsan Mountain through the large windows, and all the servers were friendly! I ordered aglio olio pasta and the seasonal strawberry pizza, and both menu items were a great success🤍

The strawberry pizza was really delicious as it was a healthy, light pizza, and the aglio olio was seasoned just right and flavorful! The food was delicious and the atmosphere was perfect, so it was a Myeongdong restaurant that I would definitely visit again in the future!

reviews.author: Seona
reviews.text:
Premium Avocado Shrimp Salad whets your appetite with a combination of fresh vegetables, plump shrimp, and soft avocado. Gamtae Pesto Octopus Gnocchi is a perfect combination of chewy gnocchi, plump octopus, and savory Gamtae sauce. Both the salad and gnocchi were fresh and flavorful, making it a satisfying meal. There are many unique menus and creative combinations, so I would like to try different menus on my next visit.
The atmosphere and service are good, so it's good for dates, gatherings, and special occasions.

reviews.author: avocado
reviews.text:
Through this visit, I felt like I could understand why this place is called the Blue Ribbon Restaurant in Myeongdong.
✔ Easily accessible location
✔ Nice interior
✔ Basic solid food taste
✔ Space configuration suitable for gatherings

In particular, I think it is a great advantage to be able to taste Italian cuisine of this quality in the middle of Myeongdong. I was satisfied as a place for a New Year's gathering with friends, and I would like to try the steak menu next time.

If you are looking for an Italian restaurant with a nice atmosphere in Myeongdong, you might want to visit at least once. Personally, I would 100% reorder the potato gnocchi and aglio olio 😊

We also recommend it for a year-end gathering, special day, or date!

reviews.author: Joohyuk Lee
reviews.text:
I had red shrimp aglioli and gorgonzola and camembert cheese pizza at Chef Manodi's Dongtan branch and was overall satisfied.
The aglioli had a strong garlic scent and plenty of plump red shrimp, making it light yet savory.
The pizza was savory with plenty of two types of cheese, and when dipped in honey, the sweet and salty combination was the best.
This restaurant has a clean atmosphere and is great for a date or family meal.

reviews.author: Fran
reviews.text: I visited with my daughter to have a quiet meal on the lively streets of Myeongdong. The chairs were comfortable and comfortable, and the view from the windows was nice. I ordered a medium-grilled sirloin steak and the meat was soft and melted. The garnish vegetables were more generous than expected and served with the steak was delicious. It was a great Bonabetti steak restaurant. I thought the tomato mare pasta was spicy, but it wasn't spicy at all. The seafood was plentiful and delicious.🍝 The green grape ade and grapefruit ade were refreshing and refreshing with fresh fruit, so I liked them🍹🥤The foreign staff were friendly and there seemed to be breakfast time because the hotel was on the same floor. Next time I want to try pizza too🍕

reviews.author: Lee Hee-seop
reviews.text:
65m from Exit 8 of Myeongdong Station, Line 4, in the middle of Myeongdong
At Myeongdong Station's pasta restaurant Bonavetti, located on the 3rd floor of the Nine Tree Hotel across the street, I enjoyed a happy meal in a luxurious and cozy atmosphere with a soft and juicy sirloin steak, red wine, spicy and savory seafood risotto in an earthen pot, and grapefruit ade.

reviews.author: M L

reviews.author: Ji “It’s in your heart” C
reviews.text:
Re-visit review after store relocation
It's much nicer that the store has expanded. Still, there is a wait. The atmosphere was nice and cozy in the old store, but having more seats is more important haha.

_______

Because this is a pizza place I love, I can't help but write a review. This is a review from several visits.

It's like wood-fired pizza, but it's not wood-fired pizza. It is described as deck oven pizza. The thin dough, which looks somewhat classic, but also the technology that creates the delicate taste that is unique to Doqument, is truly impressive.

Almost all pizzas are delicious. And it's one pizza per person. It's a taste that even women can enjoy. Half and half is available, so if you want to enjoy a variety of flavors, I highly recommend half and half. And the calzone... It's really hard to find anywhere else... Even though it tastes too much or obvious, the calzone here is special. The combination with live tomatoes really makes you feel like you've traveled to the Mediterranean the moment you take a bite.

Last tip,
1. Be sure to eat the squid rings
2. If there is seasonal pizza, be sure to try it.

reviews.author: YoungMeen Chung
reviews.text:
It is run by a chef who appeared in Black and White Chef, and the interior of the store is harmonious and nice despite the small size of the store. The star-colored green here goes particularly well during the year-end and New Year season.
As for food, I tried truffle oil pasta and sirloin steak. The pasta was cooked to al dente and topped with plenty of truffle, so it was very delicious. Here, they don't ask for the degree of doneness of the steak, they just serve it medium rare and provide a fire pit for one person at the table, so guests who want it cooked a little longer can add one piece at a time to it and eat it more. Pickles are given to guests upon request.
The price is a bit high, but the taste doesn't disappoint.

reviews.author: Yunyoung Jang
reviews.text: Euljiro 3-ga is a restaurant you must visit when you want wine. If you want to drink wine in a nice atmosphere, this is a great place to visit. This is a pasta and steak restaurant that appeared on Black and White Chef and Master of Living. I visited with an acquaintance and ordered truffle pasta, pumpkin pizza, Caesar salad, and house wine. It's great for conversation and the atmosphere is great, so I think you can make good memories even if you visit on your anniversary. The truffles on the truffle pasta were so generous and fragrant that I didn't know if I was eating just the pasta or the truffles. It was worth the price of 34,000 won. The pumpkin pizza was savory, light, and sweet, so it went well with wine. It is a wonderful place that you will definitely want to visit again when you go to Euljiro 3-ga. It's so good that it's one of the top three restaurants I've been to.

reviews.author: DN K

It also tasted fantastic paired with wine. Recommended!^^

reviews.author: mongoose

This is a place where you can eat delicious fresh pasta in the Euljiro area. We sell a lot of pasta that is difficult to find in other restaurants.
I highly recommend the chorizo ​​lily pasta. It was really delicious with just the right amount of spiciness mixed in with the umami flavor. The seafood pasta made with parsley pesto was also light and fragrant. I ordered arancini on the side, and other than being a little disappointed, I was overall satisfied.
It's a bit pricey, but the service and atmosphere are good, and there are rooms inside, so it's great for dining with family. However, please note that seats may not be available unless you make a reservation in advance.

This is where I had a blind date and meeting with my husband.
First of all, the atmosphere is really nice, the tables are wide and the interior is luxurious.
The menu is also very diverse, so there is something that everyone will like. I tried basil zucchini risotto for the first time today, and it was really delicious as the basil flavor filled my mouth, and the texture was good thanks to the crunchy fried zucchinis☺️
But above all, my favorite thing is the radicchio salad. It's a refreshing and sweet salad that you've never tasted anywhere else, so it's great to whet your appetite. The mains are all delicious, but the appetizers are so great that I recommend trying a variety of things with wine.
